text: Okay guys, so recent update on Shopify, they went ahead and changed everyone's checkout to looking like this, which is completely messing up with your conversion rate at the checkout. And guys, I'm here in the Maldives trying to relax, trying to be Zen, be in the moment, but Shopify just keeps coming up with new things that I have to make a video on and I have to go ahead and help my clients in order for them to continue scaling. So I'm right now behind the PC trying to find solution for you guys, but it all circles back to moving off of Shopify payments so that you have your own custom checkout, you can put what the hell you want on your checkout and you can continue scaling without getting any random updates and you waking up looking at your Shopify dashboard and seeing a 50% decline in sales today because Shopify went ahead and added something on your checkout.
